Inject vault secrets into a child process

Usage: kprun run [OPTIONS] <ENTRIES>... <COMMAND>...

Arguments:
  <ENTRIES>...  Vault entry titles whose secrets to inject
  <COMMAND>...  Command to run after `--` (receives injected environment variables)

Options:
      --clean-env  Inject only vault secrets and a minimal safe environment, dropping the parent environment
  -h, --help       Print help
